workspaces.description: Live queue, EMR notes, e-prescriptions with live stock, lab/imaging orders, admissions, re-route.

screens.title: My live queue

tasks.summary: Doctor: my live queue
Doctor calls the patient in (InConsultation)
Re-route / Refer to another doctor (top of their queue)

rules: Never poll: refresh from opd.queue.updated (and GET /opd-queues/me after reconnect).
Re-routed patients arrive at the TOP with is_rerouted = true — highlight them.
Re-route needs a reason; rapid re-routes without notes are flagged for review.

screens.title: Consultation (EMR)
screens.purpose: Notes, diagnosis, e-prescription, lab/imaging orders, admit, discharge; quick-action bar.

tasks.summary: Notes of one OPD visit
One note with its corrections
List patient documents
Download a patient document
Write a clinical note (draft or finalize=true)
Edit your DRAFT note
Commit the note (immutable afterwards)
Append a visible correction entry
Patient's notes (consolidated across merges)
Consolidated clinical history (EMR overview)
Close an examined visit
Doctor: Convert to VIP Waiver (after committing notes)
Doctor: Admit Patient (→ Admission_Pending)
Printable clinical note with the author's stamp
The finalized clinical note as a PDF
ICD picker: search codes by code or words
ICD picker: browse chapters, blocks, categories
One ICD code with its place in the tree
The ICD code lists loaded
Find a staff member for a form (badge facts only)

rules: CLINICAL_LOCKOUT: show error.message verbatim ('Patient ticket has been refunded…') and disable editing.
Finalized notes are never edited — offer 'Append correction' (reason required).

Examination consent before the examination field: three buttons, none selected — 'Verbal consent obtained (VCO)', 'Patient declined', 'Not examined' (examination_consent). Never pre-select one; Declined and Not examined disable the examination field. Under the Clinic profile (GET /establishment) the note cannot be finalized without it (EXAMINATION_CONSENT_REQUIRED). The printed note and prescription show 'VCO'.

Under the Clinic profile 'Submit consultation' also needs the complaint (or history), the examination findings when VCO was obtained, a diagnosis and the plan (treatment or referral): mark the empty fields from CONSULTATION_INCOMPLETE details.missing and keep the draft.

Under every finalized note and correction show its author_stamp.text (name, designation, PMDC number, date and time: MSDS 147); 'Print note' = print-payload (A4) or pdf_url, finalized notes only (ENCOUNTER_NOT_FINAL).
'Admit': admission_reason and provisional_diagnosis are required (MSDS 149); pre-fill them from this note's complaint and diagnosis for the doctor to confirm, and offer initial_care_plan.

'Procedure note' (a bedside procedure: chest drain, central line, lumbar puncture): encounter_type Procedure with `procedure` (name, site and side, indication, anaesthesia, the consent from the consent register, the assistant, start and end, technique, findings, specimens, complications, condition at the end). Mark findings, specimens ('None' if nothing was removed) and condition at the end as required; the server refuses to sign without them (PROCEDURE_NOTE_INCOMPLETE, details.missing). MSDS IMS 150.

Diagnosis codes come from the ICD picker (screen icd_picker): store the `code`, show `icd_terms` (code + title) wherever codes appear; ICD_CODE_UNKNOWN means a code not in the active list (details.unknown).
Quick-action bar: Re-route, Admit, Convert to VIP Waiver, Order lab, Order imaging, Prescribe.

POST /clinical-encounters starts new outpatient_procedures work for a Procedure note with its procedure, not an admission's: offer that choice only while outpatient_procedures is Active (GET /establishment active); the rest of the action stays.

PATCH /clinical-encounters/{encounter_id} starts new outpatient_procedures work for the procedure of an outpatient's Procedure note: offer that choice only while outpatient_procedures is Active (GET /establishment active); the rest of the action stays.
POST /admissions starts new inpatient work: offer it only while inpatient is Active (GET /establishment active).

screens.title: E-prescription builder
screens.purpose: Formulary search with live stock colours; hospital pharmacy vs external market toggle.

tasks.summary: Cancel (clinical content is never edited)
Formulary search with live stock colour
Drug stock with batches in FEFO order
E-prescription (hospital pharmacy or external slip)
Printable prescription slip
Record that the prescription was handed to the patient and how its copy is kept

rules: Show stock_status as green/amber/red; update live from pharmacy.stock.updated.
Offer 'Hospital Pharmacy' only while dispensing is Active (GET /establishment; the operation is in x-capability-gates); otherwise the only choice is the printed slip for an outside pharmacy.

External/Local Market prescriptions accept free-text drug names and print a slip; they never enter the pharmacy queue. The slip carries the prescriber's stamp (prescriber_stamp: name, designation, PMDC number, date-time) above the signature line.
Inpatient orders require dose, route, frequency (or PRN/STAT) and start time — the MAR is generated from them.

Outpatient (OPD, ER) lines need the dose, the route, how often and for how many days; a single STAT dose the dose and the route (PRESCRIPTION_INCOMPLETE, details.lines lists each line's missing fields: mark them). Pass the consultation's encounter_id so the printout carries its complaint, findings, diagnosis and VCO.

The printout (print-payload) is the standard prescription: the patient's particulars, the directions in words ('1 tablet oral twice a day for 5 days'), the prescriber's stamp and a signature line. Printing proves nothing: 'Handed over' (POST /prescriptions/{id}/handover) records to whom (patient, or a named attendant) and how the copy is kept (electronic, carbon copy, or the scan of the signed copy from the patient's documents).

Show each medicine's high_alert_category (red) and lasa_with ('looks like …', ask to confirm). A restricted medicine (is_restricted) needs the RestrictedPrescribing privilege; only PMDC doctors or holders of the Prescribing privilege prescribe (PRESCRIBER_NOT_AUTHORIZED, MSDS 52).
self_administration (inpatients): the patient may take an oral, inhaled or topical non-high-alert medicine themselves (SELF_ADMINISTRATION_INVALID otherwise).

POST /prescriptions starts new dispensing work for the hospital pharmacy (destination HospitalPharmacy): offer that choice only while dispensing is Active (GET /establishment active); the rest of the action stays.

screens.title: Refer out (external referral)
screens.purpose: Refer an outpatient or emergency patient to another facility: the letter with the reasons and the clinical summary, kept in the record; the transport; the receiving facility's acknowledgement when our staff take the patient.

tasks.summary: Refer an outpatient or emergency patient to another facility
One referral
Record the receiving facility's acknowledgement
Cancel a referral that did not happen
The referral letter (PDF)
Police stations and MLR hospitals (contact list)

rules: Open it from the consultation's quick-action bar ('Refer out') or the emergency visit; pre-fill the clinical summary from the note's complaint, findings and provisional diagnosis for the doctor to confirm.

The receiving facility: pick it from the contact list (GET /mlc/contacts, kinds ReferralHospital, TraumaCentre, BloodBank, MlrHospital) or type it when the patient chooses (tick 'at the patient's request').

Transport: Own / Ambulance / Rescue / With our staff. With our staff needs the escort's name and shows 'Acknowledgement pending' until the receiving facility's acknowledgement is recorded (who received the patient and when).
Print the letter (GET /referrals/{id}/pdf) for the patient; it stays in the record. Internal re-routing to another doctor of this establishment is not a referral (Re-route).
A referral that did not happen is cancelled with its reason; an acknowledged or cancelled one is closed (REFERRAL_CLOSED). The letter is never rewritten: cancel and write a new one.

screens.title: Lab & imaging orders + results
screens.purpose: Order tests, see published results and trends, open PACS viewer.

tasks.summary: Requisitions of one patient (newest first)
Cancel tests not yet sampled (voids an unpaid lab bill)
Active lab test catalogue (for the ordering picker)
Order lab tests for an OPD visit or an inpatient
Requisition with items, samples, results and bill status
Published results timeline of a patient (EMR)
Order imaging (doctor)
Imaging orders of a patient
Imaging order with viewer URL
Printable lab report with who performed and who verified each test
The lab report as a PDF
Printable radiology report with the reporter's stamp
The radiology report as a PDF

rules: Doctors only ever see PUBLISHED results (after lab verification), apart from a critical value released provisionally (the next rule).
A result with provisionally_released_at is an unverified critical value: show it in red with 'Pending verification', never print it; lab.result.provisional_withdrawn means do not act on it.

Cancel an order of your own while no test is sampled: POST /lab/requisitions/{requisition_id}/cancel with the reason (another doctor's order: FORBIDDEN, the lab admin cancels it; a sampled test: LAB_ITEM_STATE_INVALID, so hide the button once a sample is collected).
Critical values (has_critical_value) → red, sticky alert; acknowledge them on the critical results screen.
Show each test's is_send_out / partner_name (tell the patient it goes to that laboratory) and due_at; a rejected sample means a new one to take (the doctor is notified).

Imaging order: give the side (laterality) of a limb or paired organ; for an inpatient how they come (transport: Walking, Wheelchair, Trolley, Bed, Portable) and escort (a Doctor for special and interventional procedures). Urgent and STAT run against the emergency turnaround.
Under each result show who verified it (verified_stamp.text); under an imaging report who reported it (reported_stamp.text): MSDS 147.

'Print report': the lab report (GET /lab/requisitions/{id}/report/print-payload: published tests, reference ranges, flags, performed and verified stamps; complete false = partial) and the radiology report (GET /imaging/orders/{id}/report/print-payload), A4 or pdf_url.
Open viewer_url in a separate BrowserWindow when imaging.study.available arrives.

Exists for the service laboratory or outsourced_diagnostics or imaging (work): show it as GET /establishment views.screens says for screen_id lab_orders_results (full; open_work: without its new work, with the banner "No new ... from now on"; records: history and corrections only; setup: only from Facility settings; hidden: in no menu), after login and again on establishment.changed. Never decide it from the profile's category.

POST /lab/requisitions starts new outsourced_diagnostics work for a send-out test (availability SendOut): offer that choice only while outsourced_diagnostics is Active (GET /establishment active); the rest of the action stays.

POST /lab/requisitions starts new laboratory work for an in-house test (availability InHouse): offer that choice only while laboratory is Active (GET /establishment active); the rest of the action stays.
POST /imaging/orders starts new imaging work: offer it only while imaging is Active (GET /establishment active).

screens.title: Critical results to acknowledge
screens.purpose: The critical results of my patients: acknowledge each with the action taken.

tasks.summary: The critical results log
A critical result with who was told
Acknowledge a critical result with the action taken
Diagnostic services work waiting

faq_seed.question: What do the states of a ticket mean (Issued, Waiting, InConsultation, Examined, Completed, Deferred, Expired, Forfeited, Refunded, Void, Cancelled), and what moves it from one to the next?
The Consultation (EMR) screen says "Patient ticket has been refunded. Cannot add clinical data without an active billing slip." (CLINICAL_LOCKOUT). Why, and what do I do?
The Consultation (EMR) screen says "This ticket is no longer active; a new visit needs a new ticket." (TICKET_NOT_ACTIVE). Why, and what do I do?

The Consultation (EMR) screen says "Record the procedure, the findings, the specimens and the patient's condition at the end before signing the note." (PROCEDURE_NOTE_INCOMPLETE). Why, and what do I do?

The Consultation (EMR) screen says "Record the patient's consent to the examination (VCO), or that they declined or were not examined, before finalizing." (EXAMINATION_CONSENT_REQUIRED). Why, and what do I do?

The Consultation (EMR) screen says "A clinic consultation is finalized with the complaint, the examination findings when the patient consented, a diagnosis and the plan (treatment or referral); details.missing names what is left." (CONSULTATION_INCOMPLETE). Why, and what do I do?
The Consultation (EMR) screen says "A code is not in the active ICD code list: pick it from the ICD picker." (ICD_CODE_UNKNOWN). Why, and what do I do?
The Consultation (EMR) screen says "This service is not active here, so no new work of it can start (Settings, facility; GET /establishment)." (CAPABILITY_INACTIVE). Why, and what do I do?
The Consultation (EMR) screen says "Finalized clinical notes cannot be edited; add a correction entry." (FINALIZED_RECORD_IMMUTABLE). Why, and what do I do?
The Consultation (EMR) screen says "The patient's ER visit is still open: record how the patient left the ER first." (ER_VISIT_OPEN). Why, and what do I do?
The Consultation (EMR) screen says "This ticket cannot move to the requested state." (TICKET_TRANSITION_INVALID). Why, and what do I do?
The Consultation (EMR) screen says "Finalize the clinical note before requesting a post-consultation waiver." (POST_CONSULT_WAIVER_REQUIRES_NOTE). Why, and what do I do?
The Consultation (EMR) screen says "Record the reason for admission and the provisional diagnosis." (ADMISSION_DETAILS_REQUIRED). Why, and what do I do?
The Consultation (EMR) screen says "Only a finalized note is printed: it carries its author's stamp." (ENCOUNTER_NOT_FINAL). Why, and what do I do?
The Consultation (EMR) screen says "No code list of this classification is loaded (ICD-10: load the hospital's licensed WHO file first)." (ICD_SYSTEM_NOT_LOADED). Why, and what do I do?
The E-prescription builder screen says "The prescription cannot move to that state." (PRESCRIPTION_STATE_INVALID). Why, and what do I do?

The E-prescription builder screen says "Only a registered doctor, or a clinician the hospital allows, prescribes this; a restricted medicine needs the RestrictedPrescribing privilege." (PRESCRIBER_NOT_AUTHORIZED). Why, and what do I do?

The E-prescription builder screen says "Self-administration is only for an inpatient's oral, inhaled or topical medicine that is not high-alert, when the doctor allowed it." (SELF_ADMINISTRATION_INVALID). Why, and what do I do?

operations.when: for a Procedure note with its procedure, not an admission's
for the procedure of an outpatient's Procedure note

operations.when: for an emergency patient (source Emergency) without an open emergency visit
unless the patient has an open emergency visit

outstanding.label: Emergency patients who have not left
outstanding.how: Record each patient's departure: admitted, discharged, referred or left

capabilities.label: Operating theatre and anaesthesia

capabilities.declaration_note: Running here but not in the services declared to the PHC: add it to the declaration (PUT /phc/services)
capabilities.label: Blood transfusion
capabilities.purpose: The hospital blood bank and the bedside: units received from a licensed blood center or bank (or, for a II B or II C hospital without its own bank, under a contract), the storage log, compatibility tests, issue, the two-person bedside check, reactions, wastage and return. Donors and their blood are the blood_center service's.

capabilities.label: Blood center (donors and their blood)
capabilities.purpose: The hospital's own blood center under its PBTA licence (owner decision B1, decisions 48): donors registered once for life, the doctor's assessment and deferral, written consent, the collection, every donation's five screens and its group, components in quarantine, and their release into the blood bank's stock by two people. capabilities.declaration_note: Running here but not in the services declared to the PHC: add it to the declaration (PUT /phc/services)
capabilities.label: Maternity and newborn care

capabilities.label: Home visits
capabilities.purpose: Care at the patient's home by the establishment's doctors or nurses (the clinic manual, indicator 32). Not Active is a valid policy too: the notice for display then says home visits are not provided.

capabilities.label: Preventive programmes
capabilities.purpose: Immunization, family planning, TB-DOTS, malaria and dengue control and the like, as their national programmes run them: the list displayed, each patient's enrolment and the services given (the clinic manual, indicator 26). Retired only once every enrolment is completed or transferred.
